Purpose: Home base for ISP data analysis
- Read in data and make preliminary edits
- Preliminary visualizations
- Data processing tracking

Environment Objects Created
- bugs_raw
- bugs
- env_raw
- env
- na_summary

### Set Up

```{r}
### load packages
library(fs)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(vegan)
```


#### Env/Other
```{r}
#dropbox file path set up
dropbox_path <- path_home("Dropbox", "Stella", "data") 

# chemicals
chemicals <- read.csv(dropbox_path/"catch.csv") 

# Environmental stream data
env_raw <- read_xlsx(dropbox_path/"environ_vars.xlsx") 

env <- env_raw%>%
  group_by(stream, station, depth) %>%
  summarize(tempDepth = mean(`°C`, na.rm = TRUE),
            doDepth = mean(`DO%`, na.rm = TRUE),
            conductivityDepth = mean(`µS`, na.rm = TRUE),
            pHDepth = mean(`pH`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

sdtemp <- env_raw %>%
  group_by(stream, depth) %>%
  summarize(tempDepth = mean(`°C`, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd_temp = sd(`°C`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

sdtemp %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(sd_temp))
```

#### Bugs
```{r}
bugs_raw <- read.csv(dropbox_path/"inverts_NewDat_10.11.26.csv") %>% 
  
  #JOIN ENV DATA
  left_join(env, by = c("stream", "station", "depth")) %>%
  filter(season == "fall" ) %>%
  
  #RENAME TAXA
  rename(
    orthocladinae = orthoclad,
    oligochaeta = oligochaet,
    copepoda = copepod,
    acarina = acari,
    ostracoda = ostracod,
    tanytarsini = tanytars,
    gastropoda = gastropod,
    simuliidae = simuliid,
    empididae = empidid,
    tanypodinae = tanypod,
    ceratopogonidae = ceratopo,
    tipulidae = tipulid,
    amphipoda = amphipod,
    limoniidae = limoniid,
    insertname = crickety_thing) %>%
  
  #SET FACTOR AND LEVELS
  mutate(
    depth = factor(depth, levels = c("surber", "25", "50")),
    stream = factor(stream, levels = c("is-11", "is-10", "is-7", "is-1", "is-5", "is-6", "is-8")),
    year = factor(year),
    station = factor(station),
    tempDepth = as.numeric(tempDepth),
    doDepth = as.numeric(doDepth),
    conductivityDepth = as.numeric(conductivityDepth),
    pHDepth = as.numeric(pHDepth)
  ) %>%
  
  #REMOVE ABSENT TAXA
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x)))) %>%
  select(-insertname) %>%
  
  #REMOVE 1 Outlier
  filter(!(stream == "is-1" & station == "1" & season == "fall" & year == "2013" & depth == "surber"))


# ID COLS/META DATA
id_cols <- c("stream", "depth", "station", "season", "year", "tempDepth", "doDepth", "conductivityDepth", "pHDepth")
species_cols <- setdiff(names(bugs_raw), id_cols)

bugs <- bugs_raw %>%
  mutate(sample_id = paste(stream, depth, sep = "_")) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(species_cols), ~ as.numeric(as.character(.x)))) %>%
  filter(rowSums(across(all_of(species_cols)), na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(species_cols), ~ coalesce(.x, 0)))


# Check how many processed samples each stream contributes at each depth.
sample_counts <- bugs %>%
  count(depth, stream, name = "n_samples") %>%
  arrange(depth, stream)

sample_counts
```

# Data Cleaning
```{r}
chemicals_clean <- chemicals %>%
  filter(Stream %in% c("is1", "is2", "is3", "is4", "is5", "is6", "is7"))
```

### Preliminary Analysis Visuals
```{r}
#chemicals
chemicals_clean %>%
  group_by(Stream, Depth) %>%
  summarise(mean_SRP = mean(SRP))

chemicals_clean %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = SRP, x = Stream, color = Depth)) +
  geom_boxplot()

# Stream Temps
stream_order <- env_raw %>%
  group_by(stream) %>%
  summarise(mean_temp = mean(`°C`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(mean_temp) %>%
  pull(stream)

env_raw %>%
  mutate(stream = factor(stream, levels = stream_order),
         depth = factor(depth, levels = c("surber", "25", "50"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = stream, y = `°C`, color = depth)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Stream",
    y = "Water Temperature (°C)",
    title = "Temperature at Surface, 25 cm, and 50 cm Depths Across Streams"
  ) +
  scale_color_discrete(
    name = "Depth",
    labels = c("25" = "25 cm", "50" = "50 cm", "surber" = "Surface (0 cm)")
  )
```

### Preliminary Analysis Relationships between env vars
```{r}
#Temp vs pH
env_raw %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = pH, x = `°C`, color = depth)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

tempphmod <- lm(pH ~ `°C`, data = env_raw)
summary(tempphmod)

#Temp vs DA
env_raw %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = `DO%`, x = `°C`, color = depth)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

tempphmod <- lm(pH ~ `DO%`*depth, data = env_raw)
summary(tempphmod)

#Temp vs conductivity
env_raw %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = pH, x = `µS`, color = depth)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

tempphmod <- lm(pH ~ `µS`*depth, data = env_raw)
summary(tempphmod)
```

### Missing
```{r}
meta_cols <- c("stream", "depth", "station", "season", "year", "tempDepth", "doDepth", "conductivityDepth", "pHDepth")
taxa_cols <- setdiff(names(bugs_raw), meta_cols)

na_summary <- bugs_raw %>%
  group_by(stream, depth, station, season, year) %>%
  summarise(
    all_taxa_na = all(is.na(across(all_of(taxa_cols)))),
    na_count = sum(is.na(across(all_of(taxa_cols)))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(na_summary, aes(x = stream, y = factor(station), fill = all_taxa_na)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  facet_grid(depth ~ year + season) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "grey80", "TRUE" = "firebrick"),
    labels = c("Complete", "Missing")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Stream",
    y = "Station",
    fill = "Sample Status",
    title = "Coverage of Samples Used for Analysis"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )
```
